verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents on-demand deployments that give dedicated GPUs with 'predictable performance unaffected by other users' and no hard rate limits, which isolates traffic from serverless. It also documents autoscaling configured through firectl, covering replica counts, scale-up/down windows, load targets and scale-to-zero. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of dedicated deployment isolation and autoscaling behavior.
